faq: Are there free Santa pictures in Shepherdsville?

Yes. At Light Up Shepherdsville, the City of Shepherdsville lists free pictures with Santa and Ms. Claus at 7 pm in the Old Historic Bank Building. The 4th Annual Free Kids Winterfest also lists free pictures with Santa and Mrs. Claus, along with a Grinch photo op, in the Government Center gym.
When is the Shepherdsville Christmas parade?

The city lists the Christmas parade at 6 pm during Light Up Shepherdsville in downtown and the Town Square, with craft vendors and food trucks starting at 5 pm. The city page names a Grand Marshal and gives no street address, so use downtown Shepherdsville as your meeting point.
What is the Kids Winterfest in Shepherdsville?

The 4th Annual Free Kids Winterfest is a free evening of games, crafts and goodies at the Shepherdsville Government Center gym, 634 Conestoga Parkway. The City of Shepherdsville also lists free pictures with Santa and Mrs. Claus and a Grinch photo op, so children can mix play with photos.
What can kids do at Light Up Mt. Washington?

The Travel Bullitt calendar lists a Christmas parade, a lights display, pictures with Santa and Mrs. Claus, food trucks and live music at the City Pavilion. Kids can make reindeer food and ornaments, enter a Grinch and Whoville costume contest, collect candy canes and see a live nativity.
